svg.aria-label: Two connector options for Genie One. Option A, two REST actions: the agent calls Ask Genie One, then polls Get Genie One result with attempt 1, 2, 3 until completed, then writes the answer; about 36 Copilot Credits per question, no preview dependency, same behaviour in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams. Option B, MCP server: the agent calls View ask once; Genie's answer card polls Genie One inside the chat in Microsoft 365 Copilot; in Teams the agent answers as text; about 6 Copilot Credits per question, MCP tools are in preview. Both share the same Entra app with one federated credential per connector, the delegated subnet and private endpoint, end user authentication and Unity Catalog permissions.
svg.text: Two connector options for Genie One
Same Entra app, same private path, same per-user sign-in. They differ in how Copilot Studio waits for Genie's answer.
A · Two REST actions
NO PREVIEW DEPENDENCY
connector/genie-one-connector.swagger.yaml
Agent calls Ask Genie One
Genie One starts the answer and returns conversation_id, response_id, status in_progress
Agent polls Get Genie One result
attempt = 1, 2, 3 … until status = completed
The counter makes every poll unique, so Copilot Studio never blocks repeated calls
Agent writes the answer
Text and table from final_answer, plus the Explore in Databricks link
AT A GLANCE
• About 36 Copilot Credits per cross-domain question (8–15 tool calls)
• Same text answer in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams
• You maintain the definition (actions and schemas)
• Full control of the answer format through the instructions
• Choose when no preview features are allowed
B · MCP server
MCP TOOLS: PREVIEW
connector/genie-one-mcp-connector.swagger.yaml
Agent calls View ask once
Copilot Studio discovered Genie One's tools from the server; Allow all is off
Genie's answer card waits for the result
Microsoft 365 Copilot: the card polls Genie One through the same connector
Teams (no cards): holding message, then the agent answers as text
Agent adds one sentence and the link
The card's final answer is in the agent's context, so simple follow-ups need no new call
AT A GLANCE
• About 6 Copilot Credits per cross-domain question (1 agent tool call)
• Genie's own card in Microsoft 365 Copilot; text in Teams
• No definition to maintain; new Genie One tools stay off until reviewed
• Connector must be created inside a solution
• Choose for lower cost, if the MCP preview is accepted
SHARED BY BOTH OPTIONS
• One Entra app (copilot-genie-one-mcp) with one redirect URI and one federated credential per connector, no secret
• End user account authentication · delegated subnet → private endpoint · Genie One routes to the user's spaces · Unity Catalog decides the rows
